lines.english: What the…
What did I just try to do? What the hell did I just try to do!?
Even though I was with Setsuna just a while ago… Even though we're still supposed to be thinking about one another…
Despite all of that, the number I dialed just now belongs to…
"I'll be whoever you wish for me to be, Haruki. Whether it's a good friend, or a bad one… or perhaps even…"
…The person who said she would provide me with an escape that's simply far too convenient.
She's the one person I absolutely mustn't call right now.
It would be far too cruel a thing to do, not only to Setsuna, but to said person as well.
"The last train from Line 3 will be departing shortly. The doors are about to close. Please be careful."
"Ah…"
Somehow, I managed to muster up the last of my willpower and board the train.
I've boarded a train that will take me toward the "correct" destinationーfar away from where she lives, and toward where I live.
And so the train proceeds onward not on my route to escape, but instead back where I live, slowly leaving the surrounding white scenery trailing behind it.
Even so, I avert my gaze from the window, forgoing basic etiquette on the train as I take out my cell phone and stare at its display.
I only stare at the dull default background on the screen, which is displaying that my phone's battery is full as well as the three bars representing the phone's signal strength.
It's really nothing out of the ordinary no matter how many times I look at it; there's not supposed to be anything worth staring at, and just that…
But I don't close my cell phone. My gaze remains glued to the screen as I wait in anxious anticipation.
I have no idea why I'm doing this… No, that's actually a lie.
I'm waiting for the screen to show an incoming call…
I'm harboring the most deplorable thought that's unbecoming of the man I amーI'm holding out hope that she might call me back.
In the end, the train I was on could only make it as far as Onjuku.
I then proceeded to go home by taxi, and as it reached my apartment, the powdery snow gradually regains some of its former strength and gently comes falling down again.
It's already way past 1 AM, such that 2 AM will be arriving soon.
The temperature has dropped to the point where it stings my skin.
In contrast to Onjuku, which is bustling over Christmas, Minami-Suetsugu is already fast asleep.
As I quietly return home and gaze up into the sky as the snow falls in the middle of the night…
I finally close my phone, which had been open all this time.
After pointlessly keeping the brightness on within not only the train but also the taxi, my battery has depleted to the point where it only has one bar left remaining.
I'm absolutely pathetic…

The fact that I'm constantly waiting for her to take the initiative because I wouldn't be able to forgive myself if I ended up being the one doing it really proves that I'm a horrid, depraved, and utterly despicable person…
But, Izumi…
Weren't you the one who told me that I could always call out to you without feeling reserved?
And it's precisely during times like this where I feel really hurt and lonely that…
You show me who you truly are by letting me see that carefree smile of yours, right?
You idiot. When it actually counts… you're completely useless…
"Welcome home!"
"Merry Christmas! Miss Santa has come to visit a good little boy～!"
"…Uh, a good boy called me, so that's why I'm here, you know～?"
"Come on, don't back away like that, now! It was quite the hassle having to bring this over from work."
"Whoa～ Still, I've been freezing! I thought you'd be in your apartment, but you didn't seem to be present when I arrived."
I was too naive.
"But, you know, I figured I wanted to surprise you, so it's not like I could call you back or anything～"
I've finally sought out Izumi. I've gone out of my way to call her out of desperation.
"Thank goodness you're finally back, though～ Another hour or so and I most definitely would have ended up like the Little Match Girl."
And there's no way someone who enjoys messing around with me like her would ever pass up on such a decisive moment.
"…Haruki?"
She's always bound to do something stupid. She'll do whatever it takes just to leave me dumbfounded.
She'll even… respond to my call for her.
"Haruki, hey… nnh!?"
"You idiot…!"
"…W-Whoa～"
Izumi's body is freezing cold.
"You damn idiot…"
"Ah…"
And so I pull her into my embrace, so close that I can feel her freezing body through her clothes.
"You really are completely and utterly stupid…"
"Haruki…"
Izumi's strained breathing brushes against my ears.
"You're such a hopeless idiot. I can't believe you…"
"Really…?"
Even so, the thought of loosening my embrace does not cross my mind.
"Nn…"
I forcefully rub my face against her freezing cheek, exchanging our body heat as I feel her softness.
"Nn… ngh…"
"Hehe… you spoiled little boy."
As I thought, Izumi isn't taking this seriously and accepts me despite my forcefulness.
"Uu… uug… aahh…"
"Hey, Haruki."
She's not just hugging me back tightly, however, as she extends her arms to gently stroke my back.
"I-Izumi…"
"Come on, calm down a bit."
After caressing my back for a while, she puts her hands on my shoulders and slowly strokes my arms.
"If you behave like a good boy, Santa will give you a present, okay?"
And then, slowly and carefully, she loosens my arms, which are intertwined behind her neck.
"Ah…"
As our cheeks separate, the sight of Izumi's face reflects in my eyes.
"Ah…"
That expression…
"Okay? So close your ey… mm…!?"
It's the same vibrant smile as when I first met her.
"Nn… nn…? Ha… ahh… nn!?"
Suddenly, as if something exploded inside of me, I realize…
"Ha…Haru… nn, mhm… nn…"
No… even now, I still haven't realized exactly what I'm doing.
My vision seems to have turned into nothing but pure white as the strength I lost suddenly wells from within me in a convulsing manner.
"Nn～ aa, ah… nn… haa…"
And then gradually, inside my mouth, I'm overwhelmed by the warmth, softness, and smoothness of her lips…
"Ah, nn～ haa… ah… nn… haa…"
"Ah…"
Finally realizing the severity of my action, I pull away from Izumi's lips after indulging in the pleasure of said action, even as she showed no resistance to it.
"Hwaa～ Haaaa…"
"I-Izumi…?"
While I feel a chill down my spine from doing such an outrageous thing, I cannot deny at all that those actions have begun to thaw my frozen heart.
"Jeez～ sticking your tongue in like that all of a sudden… You're a naughty boy, Haruki."
"S-Sorry…"
"Hey, don't cry! I never said there was anything wrong with you sticking your tongue in like that."
As expected, the voice and words she used to reprimand me are gentle and playful.
"The thought just occurred to me, you see, that you're such a naughty boy, and nothing more, you know."
"You mean… you didn't mind that?"
"Of course I didn't mind. Whether you're a good boy or a bad boy, everything's okay as long as it's you, Haruki～"
"Just… give me some time to prepare myself. Like, tell me 'I'm going to put in my tongue now' or 'I'm putting it… in now…'"
"W-What do you mean?"
"Anything, really. I won't reject whatever you want to do to me… as long as it's you, Haruki."
Far beyond a joke and a little surreal, her words are filled with an intoxicating sweetness that acknowledges all of me.
"So, what's it gonna be? Wanna put your tongue in again? If so… ahhhn～"
"Nn… mm… hm… ha…"
I shove my tongue into her open mouth without hesitation and let it run wild inside.
As if allowing me to do anything I want, she relaxes her whole body and takes it all in.
"Ha…Haru… haaa… aah… nn… aahn…"
"Nn… nnnm… nnn…"
Obeying my raging lust, I run my tongue along her teeth, lick her gums, and entwine my tongue with hers as I noisily suck her saliva.
"Ha, ha… aaa… nnnnn!? Ah… haaa…"
I surrender myself to the intoxicating warmth that's coming from our exchange, but I also feel the slightest sense of discomfort welling up from within.
It's the first thing I realized the moment our tongues became deeply entwined like this.
"Nn, nnnn… ahhh… aahh…!"
"Nn… aaah…!"
Compared to even the little experience I have… in other words, even compared to Setsuna… she's clearly not used to this.
"Ngh…! Cough, cough, cough… haa, haa, haaa…"
"…Izumi?"
Despite going so far with her actions to lure me in… could it be that she doesn't exactly have much experience?
"Haaah… haaah… This… This is quite amazing."
"Are you saying that… you're not okay with this?"
Could it be that I was too fierce all of a sudden?
"It's not that… I just think maybe I wasn't mentally prepared for this? Or more like, I've realized just how conceited I've been…?"
As always, Izumi's trying to play it off as a joke, but her two arms on my shoulders have gotten heavier, and with her head down, she's breathing hard.
"S-Sorry. I, um, couldn't control myself, so…"
Because it felt far too pleasant. Because it healed me far too much.
Because I believed far too strongly that she would be able to accept everything.
"Hey, Haruki."
"Huh?"
"My legs have… gotten really cold."
Izumi, however, who should be the actual victim in this scenario, rubs her thighs exposed from her miniskirt together in response to the cold.
She doesn't let out even the slightest inkling of wanting to berate me for the humiliation I've put her through up until now.
On the contrary, her heaving and husky voice only serves to further tempt me.
"Let's continue… inside, okay?"
Hearing Izumi say those words, I inadvertently realize for the first time…
That I still haven't even entered my apartment. More specifically, we're still out on the roadside.
I ended up being so engrossed in my desire for her that I even forgot where I was.
I've even forgotten what I've been doing up until now as well as the situation I was in up until now.
"The snow…?"
"Looks like it stopped."
The quiet skies of Minami-Suetsugu are now clear of clouds.
Signaling the end of the commemorable white Christmas, the only thing left behind is the dark, cold snow that will inconvenience city life.
And also inside me, the end of something big which has been occupying my heart for a long time, and the beginning of something new… perhaps.
"Are you cold?"
"No."
"I see… hehe."
"…H-Hey…"
"Ah, don't push～ There's no room over here."
"Sleep there on the ground, then."
Such is the result of Izumi and I being cramped together on a small, narrow bed meant for one person.

The two of us have completely eliminated any excuses we have between us, whether it be the fact that we're just friends, merely classmates that attend the same seminar, or how I've simply been helping her with her paper.
"But it'll feel cold if we don't stick together."
"We can just turn on the heater."
"We need to reduce our emission of CO2～"
"Up until a few moments ago, weren't we creating lots of that?"
"Then stop moving around. Get to sleep already."
…She would probably be overjoyed by that kind of response, so I won't say it.
"That's right, sleep, sleep～ After all, we did some pretty tiring stuff～"
"…You're heavy."
Not only that, but the feeling of her feet's warmth, her tummy's softness, her breasts' far greater softness, and also… the sensation of their tips.
I can feel everything directly with my body, and I can feel something beyond just warmth that's been transmitted to me.
"What about you, Haruki?"
"…About?"
"After tiring yourself out, do you feel slightly more at ease now?"
Though what she's saying sounds contradictory, there is no room for doubt between the two of us.
Why did I call her…?
Why did I act that way the moment I saw her…?
"Think you'll be able to sleep?"
"…Yeah."
It's because Izumi understood everything.
And she also accepted everything.
"I think I can sleep, somehow."
"Because I'm here, right～?"
"…Probably."
"C-Come on, let's sleep."
"Oh～? What was that～?"
"Shut up… You were crying in pain up until a while ago."
"Ah, you want to bring that up again? I don't particularly mind, you know?"
"…Good night!"
"…Aha."
"Jeez!"
This time, I turn my back to the persistent Izumi and look out through the window at the vast expanse of the starry sky.
"Good night～ Haruki."
She rustles around inside the blanket and presses her entire body against my back.
"It's so hot."
"Yup, it's not cold～"
I disregard Izumi and tightly close my eyes.
…That's right, I close my eyes.
Though well aware of my sin, I close my eyes, unafraid of the darkness.
"It's no longer cold, Haruki."
That's because… because…
If I'm in pain, if it feels too agonizing, I can just tightly embrace this soft body that's right next to me.
I alone succumbed to the darkness yet again. And I've committed a new sin once more.
…A sin so sweet, yet one that's also incredibly unjust.
